text: Got it — I'm on the timezone plugin bug in src/plugin/timezone/index.js (parsing timestamp / native Date / Day.js object inputs in dayjs.tz). A subagent is investigating and fixing it now; I'll confirm when it's fixed and the test suite is green.

Noted — bug #2 (`Convert format Z`, also in src/plugin/timezone/index.js) is being worked on now by a second investigator, alongside bug #1. ETA ~8 min for both; I'll report as soon as each is fixed and verified.

Bug #4 fixed: src/locale/nl.js had `ordinal: n => `${n}.`` instead of `ordinal: n => `${n}e``, so `format('Do')` gave '1.'/'31.' instead of '1e'/'31e'. Fixed and verified for days 1–31; full suite still 56 suites / 524 tests passing.

Bug #5 fixed: weekYear() in src/plugin/weekYear/index.js only handled the December→next-year case and never the January→previous-year case, so with `yearStart: 4` (ISO) early-January dates in week 52/53 returned the wrong year (e.g. 2017-01-01 → 2017 instead of 2016). Added the missing `month === 0 && weekOfYear >= 52 → year - 1` branch. Verified against moment over 13,140 consecutive dates; full suite still 56 suites / 524 tests passing.

Bug #1 fixed: `dayjs.tz(input, tz)` was running every input through the wall-clock `fixOffset` path, so timestamps / native Date / Day.js objects (already absolute instants) were shifted by the zone offset. Now only offset-less strings use the wall-clock path; everything else is converted as an absolute instant. Verified: dayjs.tz(1234567891011,'America/New_York'), dayjs.tz(new Date(...),NY), dayjs.tz(dayjs(...),NY) and dayjs(...).tz(NY) all give valueOf=1234567891011, format '2009-02-13T18:31:31-05:00', utcOffset -300. Full suite 56/56 suites, 524/524 tests passing.

Bug #7 fixed: the customParseFormat plugin matched `A`/`a` with hard-coded English regexes and never consulted the locale's `meridiem`, so locales with non-English AM/PM strings (zh-cn 上午/下午, ja 午前/午後, br a.m./g.m., custom meridiem functions) produced Invalid Date. Now it captures the word and resolves it via the locale's meridiem (falling back to English PM/pm when the locale has none). Verified for en, zh-cn, ja and a custom meridiem locale against moment; existing tests unchanged (38 passed; full suite 56 suites / 524 tests).
